info.description:
Demo collection for querying FHIR DiagnosticReport resources by patient NHI, status, and previewing the HTML presentedForm.

## Setup
1. Set the `base_url` variable to your FHIR server (e.g. https://your-fhir-server.com/fhir)
2. Set the `patient_nhi` variable to the patient's NHI number
3. If your server requires auth, set `auth_token` to your Bearer token

## Presented Form (HTML Preview)
The last two requests extract the base64-encoded HTML from `presentedForm` and let you view it in Postman's Visualize tab.
